ei.title: Peter stepped out of the freezing night air and in
ei.subject: 6월 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Peter stepped out of the freezing night air and in

fullPassage: Peter stepped out of the freezing night air and into the brightly lit hospital lobby, holding his three-year-old daughter in his arms. The harsh light made her look even more unwell, her face all red and sweaty. Her fever had started suddenly, just before dinner, but it wouldn't go down despite his efforts. At the front desk, he explained her symptoms, his concern growing with every moment. They were quickly led to the doctor, who reassured him and carefully examined his daughter. After the doctor gave her a shot, her fever went down and she seemed more comfortable. As Peter watched her sleep peacefully that night, he felt a wave of calm wash over him.

det.analysis: ①응급 대처법이 아닌 감정 변화 중심 ②야간 진료 중요성은 부차적 ③딸의 건강(열→회복)과 Peter의 감정(걱정→안도)이 글의 핵심 ←정답 ④의사 진료 과정은 부분적
det.tip: 글 전체: 딸 아픔 → Peter 걱정 → 치료 → 안도

ch: 아이의 건강과 부모의 걱정 및 안도

questions.passage: Peter stepped out of the freezing night air and into the brightly lit hospital lobby, holding his three-year-old daughter in his arms. The harsh light made her look even more unwell, her face all red and sweaty. Her fever had started suddenly, just before dinner, but it wouldn't go down despite his efforts. At the front desk, he explained her symptoms, his concern growing with every moment. They were quickly led to the doctor, who reassured him and carefully examined his daughter. After the doctor gave her a shot, her fever went down and she seemed more comfortable. As Peter watched her sleep peacefully that night, he felt a wave of calm wash over him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: Peter가 아픈 딸을 데리고 병원에 간 이야기
det.analysis: ①본문에 의사와 사전 통화 내용 없음 ←정답 ②gave her a shot → more comfortable — 일치 ③watched her sleep peacefully — 일치 ④harsh light made her look even more unwell — 일치
det.tip: 본문에 없는 정보 = 불일치

ch: Peter는 병원에 도착하기 전에 이미 의사와 통화했다.
Peter의 딸은 주사를 맞고 나서 편안해졌다.
Peter는 딸이 평화롭게 잠드는 것을 지켜보았다.
병원 로비의 강한 조명이 딸을 더 아파 보이게 했다.
